crossRefs.note: If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God gives you to dwell there, that
and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified…
It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
“Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,
translations.bsb: and if it is reported and you hear about it, you must investigate it thoroughly. If the report is true and such an abomination has happened in Israel,
translations.kjv: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:
translations.asv: and it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, then shalt thou inquire diligently; and, behold, if it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel,
